# 0.20.1 — 3 November 2026

Patch on 0.20.0. A `visibility.toml` log source is one dataset, named by its `name` (the KQL table, Splunk sourcetype or Elastic index pattern), and can declare the dataset's columns, which the query checks from [opentidehq/language-server 0.7.1](https://github.com/opentidehq/language-server/releases/tag/v0.7.1) check, hover and complete. `lint` checks files that start with a UTF-8 byte-order mark, MCP `validate_query` reads `visibility.toml`, and `lint.toml` sets the filename convention per object kind.

**Why a patch.** The release-management rule makes a change to accepted input a minor. This one is a patch by maintainer decision: the 0.20.0 `visibility.toml` dataset lists were a defect of `visibility::1.0`, shipped the same day, and are corrected in place. The schema identifier stays `visibility::1.0`.

## Upgrade

```bash
pip install opentide==0.20.1
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

A workspace that used the 0.20.0 dataset lists rewrites `visibility.toml` with one `[[logsources]]` per table, sourcetype or index pattern, named after it, and updates the signals' `data.logsources` references to the new names. Everything else needs nothing. There is no migration command; see [Upgrading from 0.20.0](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/blob/development/docs/usage/configuration.md#upgrading-from-0200).

| 0.20.0 | 0.20.1 |
|--------|--------|
| `tables = ["A", "B"]`, `sourcetypes`, `indices` on one log source | one `[[logsources]]` per dataset, `name = "A"`; the old keys fail validation (`schema_validation`) and say what to do |
| `indexes`, `macros`, `data_views`, `ecs` | not declarable; remove them |
| no way to declare a dataset's columns | `[logsources.columns]` keyed by column name, `{ type, description }` |
| once tables were declared, an unknown Defender table was only a warning | `kql_unknown_table` at the profile's severity again (an error under `defender_for_endpoint`) |

## Added

- **`lint.toml` sets the filename convention per object kind** ([#721](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/721)): `[filenames.threats]`, `[filenames.objectives]` and `[filenames.rules]` take `style` and `pattern`; a kind without a table follows `[filenames]`.

## Changed

- **The engine is language-server 0.7.1** ([release](https://github.com/opentidehq/language-server/releases/tag/v0.7.1)): declared columns are checked (`kql_unknown_column`, `kql_type_mismatch`) and shown in hover and completion; an unknown table keeps its profile's severity once tables are declared, so Defender typos fail again; lower-case table names are checked; column patterns in `project-reorder`, `project-away` and `project-keep` parse; a document with a byte-order mark is analysed.
- **ATT&CK 20.0 group labels** in generated docs and editor schemas (`[Enterprise] APT28` where it said `[Mobile] APT28`). `threat::1.0` accepts the same values.

## Fixed

- **A `visibility.toml` log source is one dataset, with its columns: `visibility::1.0` is corrected in place** ([#718](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/718), [specifications#63](https://github.com/opentidehq/specifications/issues/63), [spec](https://github.com/opentidehq/specifications/blob/main/specs/visibility.md)).
- **`opentide lint` checks the queries of an object file that starts with a UTF-8 byte-order mark** ([#719](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/719)).
- **MCP `validate_query` knows the datasets the workspace's `visibility.toml` declares** ([#720](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/720)), read afresh on every call.

See the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/blob/development/CHANGELOG.md) for every change. Tracking issue: [#722](https://github.com/opentidehq/opentide/issues/722).

## Verify

```bash
pip install opentide==0.20.1
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"   # 0.20.1
opentide doctor                                             # analysis_engine: language server 0.7.1
```
